shortDescription: Make quick work of large loads with mega capacity and the timesaving TurboWash® 360° technology. Easily find just the right cycle with hybrid electronic controls offering the quick convenience of a dial plus helpful information and more options through the LCD display. Or let LG built-in intelligence do it for you, with AI technology and advanced sensors that detect fabric texture and load size to automatically select the perfect settings.

features.text: Go Big to Save Time and Get More Done

Say never again to never-ending piles of laundry—this mega capacity washer fits more clothes in every load and helps you power through laundry day in less time. With 5.0 cu. ft. capacity, you can fit a king-size comforter and more in a single load, for big time savings every week. Get the room and flexibility to clean in fewer loads.
Built-In Intelligence Takes Out the Guesswork

Forget about endless sorting or toggling through cycles—built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture and load size, then automatically select the right wash motions, temperatures and more for advanced fabric care.
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes

With TurboWash® 360°, you can clean larger loads fast and get more done while enjoying the same great washing performance you expect from LG. Five powerful jets with variable sprays surround clothes from multiple angles so detergent can penetrate deep into fabrics for a complete clean in under 30 minutes.
Deep Clean with the Power of Steam

The Allergiene® cycle uses the gentle power of steam to reduce common household allergens such as pet dander and pollen in fabrics by up to 99.9%—without harsh chemicals. It’s perfect for bedding, baby clothes and more.
Give Your Pets a Glow-Up

We love our pets, but that doesn’t mean we have to live with pet odor. The Pet Care cycle helps reduce odors in pet clothes, toys and blankets—and people clothes, too! It combines high-temp water settings with optimal wash times followed by a 4-step rinsing process to ensure items come out clean and smelling fresh. Simply touch Settings on the panel, choose “More Cycles” Edit and select Pet Care.
Turn up the Style

Turn the dial—and turn up the style. The simplicity of dial controls gets a modern upgrade with an intuitive touch panel and LCD display that give you all the details you need with a quick glance. It’s a perfect complement to this washer’s sleek, contemporary look featuring a flat front design, elegant finish options and tinted, tempered glass door with chrome rim.
Premium Looks Designed to Last

LG front load washers and dryers use tempered glass doors for a sleek, stylish look that resists shock and scratches. Chrome door rim and matching control knob complement the door and enhance the premium feel.
Smooth Surface Helps Prevent Snags
Unlike tubs made from porcelain or plastic, the LG NeveRust® Stainless Steel Tub avoids the chips and nicks that can snag fabrics and ruin clothing.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage and monitor your washer remotely, track and download cycles, connect with Google or Alexa voice assistants, and access smart diagnosis, customer support, and more. ThinQ Care appliances send usage, maintenance, and diagnostic alerts to help you keep them running smoothly. ThinQ UP appliances receive software updates for new features and enhancements.
Smart Pairing
With Smart Pairing™, the washer can even tell the dryer to select a compatible drying cycle, making it the ultimate laundry hack.
Wash Two Loads at the Same Time

Add the one-of-a-kind LG SideKick® 27" pedestal washer(Sold separately) and wash small loads that just can’t wait in the compact washer below while you do a big load up top. Warm and cold settings and 6 cycles let you care for all types of items, from delicates and hand washables to workout wear and baby clothes. Elevate your washer for easier loading and unloading.
